name: MMDA
summary: MMDA, also known as 3-methoxy-4,5-methylenedioxyamphetamine or as 5-methoxy-MDA, is a psychedelic and entactogen of the amphetamine family.

pharmacology.text: MMDA has been shown to act as a non-neurotoxic serotonin releasing agent, with no effects on release of dopamine or probably norepinephrine, and as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist. The latter property is thought to be responsible for its psychedelic effects, whereas the former action may be involved in its entactogenic effects.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin releasing agent; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Entactogen

sideEffects.text: Side effects of MMDA have been reported to include restlessness, cold sensations, shivering, nausea, abdominal cramps, disorientation, social withdrawal, feeling ill, and anxiety.
